text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard cafe permit located at 2261 Queen Street East, Hammersmith Avenue flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until the April 7, 2020 Toronto and East York Community Council meeting.
